mandate.target: a red CI/deploy or dark prod gets exactly one fix-or-revert PR within one fire cycle, deduped per SHA
checklist: call check.sh FIRST, every run -- deterministic, zero LLM spend if green
prod-down outranks a build-red fire -- check.sh buckets its dedup key by 30-minute window, not SHA
check.sh fires once per failing SHA -- its own state file blocks re-firing on the same head until it changes
on fire: fresh worktree off the default branch, fix or explicit revert
never push directly to the default branch -- PR-backed only, arm auto-merge same as gru
check.sh emits a 6-hourly liveness heartbeat even on quiet ticks so a deadman audit can tell quiet from dead
mandate.escalation: a fix isn't obvious within the turn budget -- open an explicit REVERT PR instead of guessing at a fix; never push directly to the default branch under any circumstance, even a dark prod. If PROD_DOWN and no FIXER_PROD_DIAG_DRIVER is configured, log the gap loudly and stop -- do not invent ad hoc prod access.
